title: Smart Data Models - Allotrope Foundation Ontologies - AssayResult
description: The AFO definition of 'assay result' is derived from IUPAC terminology (dct:license iupac-license, 'Reproduced by permission of IUPAC') and is not reproduced here; see the source IRI. (AFO REC/2026/09 class 'assay result', http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0000207. The entity type is the PascalCase form of the AFO skos:prefLabel; attribute names are the camelCase form of the prefLabels of the AFO relations and facet classes they stand for.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AssayResult'

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. The name of this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

afoClass.description: Property. Not an AFO term (Smart Data Models addition): the AFO classes this entity is an instance of, given by their skos:prefLabel, verbatim. Stands for rdf:type; covers the 24 classes of the AFO REC/2026/09 'assay result' branch (the root class and all its subclasses, including classes defined by owl:equivalentClass).

assayDataIdentifier.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0002019'. AFO class 'assay data identifier': An assay data identifier is an identifier that identifies some assay data. Assay data is a description of an assay containing parameters and results of the assay and metadata about the assay. [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON.

measurementTime.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0000952'. AFO class 'measurement time': The date/time of the measurement. [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON.

quantity.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0001101'. The AFO quantification facet class this value is an instance of, given by its skos:prefLabel, verbatim (e.g. 'mass', 'mass concentration', 'flow rate', 'sample weight'). 179 classes of the AFO REC/2026/09 'quantification facet' branch.

numericValue.description: Property. Model:'http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#numericValue'. QUDT 'has numeric value': the number of the quantity value, in the given unit.

unit.description: Property. Model:'http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#unit'. QUDT 'has unit': IRI of the unit of measure, from the QUDT 1.1 unit vocabulary (http://qudt.org/vocab/unit#...) or the Allotrope QUDT extension (http://purl.allotrope.org/ontology/qudt-ext/unit#...), both distributed with AFO (qudt-ext REC/2026/09, 867 units), e.g. http://qudt.org/vocab/unit#DegreeCelsius.

standardUncertainty.description: Property. Model:'http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#standardUncertainty'. The standard uncertainty of a quantity is the estimated standard deviation of the mean taken from a series of measurements. [QUDT] Same unit as numericValue.

hasFacet.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/property#AFX_0002803'. AFO 'has facet': Relation between an information content entity and some part of it called a facet that is covers some general aspect of information context. [Allotrope] Flattened: in AFO the bearer is quantified by a quantity value (qudt:QuantityValue, typed with an AFO quantification facet class) that has a numeric value and a unit; here each item gives that class (quantity), numericValue, unit and optionally standardUncertainty. Holds the reported quantity values of the result.

dataOutputOf.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/property#AFX_0002734'. AFO 'data output of': Inverse of 'has data output'. [Allotrope] Points to the PlannedProcess entity that produced this result.

isAbout.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000136'. AFO 'is about': (No skos:definition in AFO; skos:example: This document is about information artifacts and their representations. [IAO]) Points to the PortionOfMaterial entities (samples) the result is about.
